name: Yoga Wellness Center
benefit: Under this scheme, Yoga, naturopathy, and counseling services are provided based on the individual’s health condition. For this, the OPD fee is ₹1.00 per person in rural areas and ₹2.00 per person in urban areas.
_eligibility_text: 1. The beneficiary must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The beneficiary can belong to any age group. 1. The beneficiary must be registered at an identified Government Ayurvedic Centre or Hospital.
